system_message: Generate Figma-compatible design specifications. Describe the UI/UX elements, layout, colors, typography, and interactions.
prompt_template:
Design Brief: {user_input}

Design Parameters:
- Canvas Size: {width}x{height}
- Component Count: {components}
- Complexity Level: {complexity}

Design System:
- Style: Modern, clean, professional
- Typography: Clear hierarchy, readable fonts
- Colors: Harmonious palette, accessible contrast
- Layout: Responsive, well-structured
- Components: Reusable, consistent

Deliverables:
- Component library
- Design tokens
- Layout specifications
- Interaction states
